title: Official Statistics: Schedule of updates and announcements for VO statistics
summary: Publication plan for Valuation Office (VO) Official Statistics and Ad-hoc publications. This includes any proposed changes to statistical outputs.

title: Keep your HMRC online security information safe as an agent
summary: Find out how to protect your sign in details and reduce the risk of fraud when using HMRC online services.

title: HMRC email updates, videos and webinars for tax agents and advisers
summary: Learn more about the support available to tax agents and advisers which will help you and your clients.

title: Form: Community Amateur Sports Club registration form CASC (A1)
summary: Use online form or postal form CASC (A1) to register your club as a Community Amateur Sports Club (CASC).

title: Trust Registration Service Manual
summary:
The Trust Registration Service (TRS) is the Government's
register of trusts; it is part of the Government's wider strategy to prevent
money laundering and terrorist financing.

title: Capital Gains Manual
summary:
HMRC is reviewing the CG Manual to ensure it provides
HMRC’s interpretation of relevant legislation where there is more than one
reasonable view of how rules work.Where material in the CG Manual isn’t
providing an interpretation, that material is being removed. Where appropriate,
material will be reproduced elsewhere and linked from the CG Manual.

title: Guidance: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Imports
summary: This guide provides detailed completion instructions for data elements when making an import declaration to the Customs Declaration Service (CDS).

title: Data Element 2/3: Documents and Other Reference Codes (National) of the Customs Declaration Service (CDS)
summary: Find a list of codes for the relevant document codes, document status codes and details to be declared (for example, licences and certificates) in Data Element 2/3 (Appendix 5A).

title: Food processing services (VAT Notice 701/40)
summary: Check the VAT rules for food processing and abattoir services.

title: Administrative agreements with trade bodies (VAT Notice 700/57)
summary: Read details of administrative agreements relating to VAT on certain specific transactions between members of trade bodies and HMRC.

title: Form: Self Assessment: Capital gains summary (SA108)
summary: Use supplementary pages SA108 to record capital gains and losses on your SA100 Tax Return.

title: Guidance: Customs civil penalties
summary: Find out about the law and regulations for customs civil penalties.

title: Form: Inheritance Tax: jointly owned assets (IHT404)
summary: Use the IHT404 with form IHT400 to give details of all UK assets the deceased owned jointly with another person.

title: Check genuine HMRC contact that uses more than one communication method
summary: Check recent contacts from HMRC to help you decide if a suspicious email, phone call, text or letter could be a scam.

title: Policy paper: HMRC issue briefing: tax fraud warning about ‘Bills of Exchange’ schemes
summary: This briefing explains ‘Bills of Exchange’ schemes which are being promoted as alternative ways of paying HMRC liabilities.

title: Choose the right software for Pillar 2 Top-up Taxes
summary: Find out what commercial software you will need to report Domestic Top-up Tax and Multinational Top-up Tax.

title: Form: Self Assessment: Trust and Estate Tax Return (SA900)
summary: Use form SA900 to file a Trust and Estate Tax Return.

title: Tell HMRC about a student or postgraduate loan in your tax return
summary: If you complete a Self Assessment tax return, you must use it to tell HMRC about your student or postgraduate loan deductions.

title: Form: Genuine diversity of ownership clearance (CISC5)
summary: Use form CISC5 for advance clearance if an Authorised Investment Fund meets the genuine diversity of ownership condition.

title: Official Statistics: Numbers of taxpayers and registered traders
summary: This publication shows the estimated number of taxpayers with a tax liability arising during the year rather than those paying tax during the year, and the number of traders registered at 31 March.
